text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week, Grass Wonder, T.M. Opera O—surrounded by all these powerful opponents, Meisho Doto loses confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, her lack of courage is offset by an abundance of determination. She takes to the turf, backed by a long history of persistent effort!
